Commentary.Commentary: Right! England have got a task in their hand if they are to whitewash the Proteas. 192 is what they want. Will they be able to do so? Remember that South Africa are without Kagiso Rabada in this game. We have got a game in our hands folk! Join us on the other side in a bit.

A very ordinary bowling performance from England. They started off decently but were taken to the cleaners in the death. We usually do not see that from this English side. Ben Stokes and Adil Rashid were superb in the middle phase. With Stokes finishing with 2/26 from his 3. Rashid was economical too but failed to get any wicket. Archer, Tom, Sam Curran and Jordan were all expensive. Overall they will be disappointed with their bowling performance at the death.

After opting to bat, South Africa started off cautiously and lost both de Kock and Bavuma after a steady start. The pair of Faf du Plessis and Rassie van der Dussen started off slowly and it looked like 160 would be good enough. The duo though after taking their time to settle fired on all cylinders. Both got to their respective fifties and their massive 127-run stand off just 66 balls turned the tide of the game and propelled them to a total in excess of 190!

Brilliant finish from South Africa and the massive stand between Faf du Plessis and Tassie van der Dussen has taken the side to a total that is well above average on this venue. 84 from the last 5 overs has rocketed them to 191. Brilliant from the pair of van der Dussen and du Plessis

Good stop near the fence! A short ball from Jordan, Rassie pulls it hard towards the deep square leg fielder. Sam runs to his left and catches the ball near the fence. He realizes that momentum will take him over the line so he throws the ball in. Archer returns it to the keeper. Two taken. South Africa end with 191/3.

SIX! Connects this time and sends it sailing over the ropes. A fuller ball from Jordan, it is right in the hitting zone. Van der Dussen hammers it down the ground and it goes way back in the stands at long off. What a strike.
A dot! Full and wide outside off, van der Dussen looks to hit it hard but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Two now. Full and on middle, van der Dussen flicks it hard towards deep mid-wicket. Archer fails to pick the ball cleanly. Two taken.
SIX! A biggie now! That is put away from Rassie. Full and wide outside off, Rassie slams it over long off for a maximum. 4th biggie in the innings for him.
FOUR! Whipped away! Four boundaries in a row for South Africa. Jordan misses his yorker and ends up bowling a low full toss. Van der Dussen flicks it over square leg and gets a boundary.

EDGY FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries for Faf! He gets to his half ton. Struggled a bit at the start but held his end and now is taking South Africa to a very good score. Sam misses his yorker and bowls a wide full toss. Faf looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge that races away to the thrid man fence. Superb innings from the experienced pro.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. The mid off was inside the ring and du Plessis clears him. Full and wide again, Faf hammers it over the mid off fielder and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and wide outside off, this time Faf goes over cover-point and finds the fence. He moves to 44.
Play and a miss! A full toss outside off, du Plessis looks to drive but fails to connect.
WIDE! Sam wants to stay away from the firing line. Tries doing that with a wide yorker but ends up bowling it way outside off. Wided.
Full and wide again, driven to sweeper cover for one.
Two now! Full and wide outside off, it is lifted over cover for two.
WIDE! Sam starts with a wide. Goes for a fuller and wider one but ends up bowling it way outside off. Rassie fails to connect. Wided.
Sam Curran is back for his second spell. This time in death. Didn't bowl in the death in the last game. 2-0-18-0 are his numbers so far.

Dot to end a good over for England. Went for six on the first ball, a no ball too but just 9 from the over. Full and wide outside off one more time, Faf squeezes it out but straight to the point fielder.
Full and wide again, Rassie pushes it through covers for one.
Another yorker! Jordan has realized that these two are reading the slower ones really well so he is back to bowling the full ball. Faf keeps it out down to fine leg for one.
Nothing off the Free Hit. Top delivery from Jordan. Yorker outside off, Faf once again fails to connect.

NO BALL! Oops! That sliiped out of his hand it seems. Jordan apologizes straightaway. Very high full toss, Faf manages to just pull it away somehow. Falls down in the process. No ball called. Free Hit coming up.
Good comeback from Jordan. This time a knuckle ball. Full and wide, du Plessis fails to hit it.
SIX! Another mighty hit! This time from Faf. 150 is up now. Jordan getting the stick now. A slower one from him. Full and outside off, Faf slams iit over long off for a biggie.
Change in bowling. Chris Jordan is back on.
Two now and it fifty for van der Dussen. 22 from the over. An expensive night for Archer. Short ball on middle, Rassie pulls it down ot deep mid-wicket and gets two. Brings up a fine half ton.
SIX! WHACKED AWAY! What an over for South Africa. Still one ball to go. A length ball, right in the slot for van der Dussen. He powers it over deep mid-wicket for a huge six.
A dot! Good bouncer from Archer. It is just outside off, Rassie sways away.

FOUR! DRILLED! Hat-trick of boundries for Rassie and South Africa. Full and outside off, van der Dussen slams it down the ground. No chance for Jofra to even think of stopping that. That was hit with a lot of muscle.
The phsyio is out to have a check on the cut Stokes has got on his hand. Looks painful, Stokes is walking off the field and Billings is on the field in place of him.

FOUR! That is hit really hard. Runs flowing thick and fast for South Africa now. Fuller and around off, van der Dussen slams it over mid on. Long on tries to get around by moving to his left but fails to stop the ball. Stokes is the man and he has a cut near his finger.
SIX! WALLOP! Rassie joins the act now and Archer gets the treatment. Another slower one, this time it is outside off, van der Dussen slogs it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Jofra Archer to bowl out. 0/22 from his 3!

SIX! BOOM! Six to begin the over, six to end it as well. That is some strike for Faf du Plessis. Another slower one and Tom bangs it short again. Du Plessis swings it through the line and deposits it over deep sqlare leg for a biggie.
Slower bouncer! Pulled to deep square leg for one by van der Dussen.
Good running! A length ball around middle, Rassie works it through mid-wicket. The call is for two straightaway. Easily done.
Another slower one, Faf pulls it or rather mistimes his pull to long on for one.
Good comeback! Lovely change of pace from Tom. It is just outside off, du Plesiss swings hard but makes no connection.
SIX! And he is welcomed with a biggie. A length ball around off, du Plesiss launches it over the bowler's head and clears the fence. Top shot. 50-run stand is up between the two.
Here's Tom Curran again! Went for 8 in his first over.

FOUR! Top shot to finish the over. Nothing much wrong with the delivery but Rassie was too good. Very ful on off, van der Dussen clears his front leg and hits it in the gap through mid-wicket for a boundary,
On off, punched to cover for one.
Another off-pace delivery outside off. Rassie chops it to the right of the keeper. Jordan shouts hit it Jos. Buttler has a shy at the bowler's end. Jordan is quick to move away but JB still misses.
Length bll on off, plays it to long on and gets a run.
Slower ball bowled into the surface. Rassie mistimes his pull to long on and takes a single. Brings up the 100 for the hosts.
On middle, Faf whips it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Bowling change! Chris Jordan is back on. 1-0-4-1 from him so far.
On the pads, Faf turns it to the on side and keeps the strike.
Short ball from Archer. Rassie pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, du Plessis places it through mid on. The former skiper looks for two but the fielder is quick to get to the ball. Just a run.
Good comeback from Archer! Hits the deck hard and makes the ball rise. It is around the body. Du Plessis looks to defend but does so off the upper half of his bat.
FOUR! Good shot and nicely placed! Full around off, it is in the zone for Faf. He hits it across the line over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Archer starts his new spell with a length ball around off. Rassie plays it through point for one.
Bowling change. Archer is back on! 2-0-14-0 from him so far.
Rashid ends his spell with a dot! Flat and outside off, Faf moves on the leg side and drives it on the up but finds cover. 3-0-20-0! Economical spell again from Rashid.
Muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. Loopy ball on the pads, du Plessis looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pad. An appeal but it dies down quickly.
Short and wide, cut to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Rassie finds the fence again. Short ball on middle, he gets in position quickly and pulls it hard past the diving deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Loopy again, Faf lifts it over mid off for one. Wanted to go inside out but mistiemd it.
Nicely bowled! Tossed up and outside off, du Plessis looks to drive it over extra cover but gets an inside edge on the pads.
SIX! Hammered! A bumper from Stokes but it sits up nicely for van der Dussen. It is just around off, Rassie hammers it over deep square leg for half a dozen. Good end to the over for the Proteas.
Tucks the next ball through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for South Africa. A fuller ball on middle and leg, du Plessis moves across to the off side and scoops it through short fine leg for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, stroked through cover-point for one.
Length ball around off, pushed towards mid off.
Shortish and outside off, Rassie punches it wide of the sweeper cover and gets two.
Just a single and it is another tidy over from Rashid. Flat and around off, punched down to long on for a run.
One more single! Flatter and just outside off, this one is punched through covers for one.
Tossed up and around off, guided towards backward point for a quick single.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
This time he goes for the sweep as Rashid gives the ball loop and bowls it on middle, du Plessis finds short fine leg now.
Short and wide outside off, Faf looks to drive but mistimes it towards the cover fielder.
Singe to end the 10th over! A successful one for England. Back of a length ball on middle, du Plessis pulls it towards fine leg and keeps the strike for the next over. 66/3 at the halfway mark.
Van der Dussen is up and running. Short ball, slower again. Rassie tucks it towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Back of a length ball around middle, van der Dussen keeps it out.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! That is a good low catch from Buttler. Stokes gets his second. A slower one from Stokes, it is just outside off, Hendricks looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes behind but as it goes to Buttler, it keeps dying down. Buttler does well to get down to his right a little and does well to get the gloves around the ball with a tumble. The umpires want to confirm if it has carried directly to Buttler and repalys roll in to confirm it has.
Back of a length ball just outside off, pushed towards the cover fielder for nothing.
Length ball outside off, poked through backward point for one.
A single to end! Just the two from the over. Flatter and just outside off, du Plessis stays behind and pushes it through point for one to open his account.
Three dots in row for Faf. This one is slightly quicker and flat. Du Plessis pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted and around off, driven nicely but straight to mid off.
Tossed up and on off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
On middle, Reeza flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Shortish and on middle, pulled towards short fine leg for nothing.
Who will walk out to bat at number 4? It is the former skipper, Faf du Plessis.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stokes gets Bavuma. A length ball just outside off, Bavuma looks to clear the infield but he doesn't get the needed elevation. Jordan at mid off moves a little left from his position and takes the catch easily. Good, little innings but South Africa needed him to continue. Stokes with the knack  of getting wickets gets one.
Shouts for the second again and makes it easily. Stokes is not happy. A length ball around off, Bavuma pushes it through mid on. The call is for two. They get it easily.
Excellent running between the wickets. Short and just outside off, it is pushed to the right of the third man fielder. Bavuma calls for the second and makes it.
Sharp bouncer! The effort ball from Stokes. It is aimed perfectly. Bavuma looks to pull but misses.
Pushes the next short ball outside off to the right side of the third man for one.
FOUR! Stokes is welcomed with a boundary. Super shot from Hendricks. A length ball outside off, Hendricks drills it through the covers and it races away to the boundary.
Bowling change again! Here's Big Ben!
SIX! Boom! Bavuma ends the over with a biggie and spoils Rashid's first. Slightly overpitched on middle. Bavuma clears his front leg and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Short on off, Bavuma punches it to point and looks for a run. Reeza though is quick to turn it down and send Temba back.
Flighted on off, Hendricks pushes it to cover for one.
Beauty! Not a big spin but good spin from Rashid. Bowls a leg break which pitches on off. Hendricks looks to defend but the ball turns away and beats the outside edge of Reeza's willow.
Floated on off, Hendricks is happy to calmly defend it.
Rashid starts with a short ball on off. Bavuma pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Bowling change! Here's Adil Rashid.
Shrot ball on off. Hendricks blocks it. End of an eventful first over from Tom Curran. 8 from it.  End of the Powrplay and South Africa are 44/1 at the end of the first phase.

EDGED AND FOUR! Very good ball from Tom Curran. Pacy ball pitched on a length outside off. Reeza Hendricks looks to slash it on the off side but the ball shapes away and kisses the outside edge. The ball flies to the right of Buttler. Jos dives, gets a little bit of finger tips on it but can't hold onto it. The ball races away to the third man fence.
Length delivery on off. Temba taps it to point and gets a single.
Fuller on leg. Bavuma makes room away from the stumps and flicks it uppishly in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
On the pads, Reeza tickles it behind square leg for a single.
Tom starts with a good length ball on middle and leg. Reeza taps it to mid on.
Change from both ends. The older Curran, Tom, comes in to bowl now.

Almost another one. A length ball just outside off, Hendricks looks to defend but gets an inside edge. The ball goes to short fine leg and they take a single. End of a successful and a record-breaking over.

Direct hit and Bavuma would have been heading home. A length ball outside off, Bavuma pushes it towards Stokes at covers. He goes for the single. Stokes picks the ball and throws it at the non-striker's end, all in one motion but he misses. Had he hit, Bavuma would have had to join his skipper in the pavilion. Also, Had Jordan ran back to the bowling mark, he would've been able to catch Bavuma short.
Reeza Hendricks replaces his skipper out in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Jordan strikes and it is the massive wicket of de Kock. Big breakthrough for England. A length ball from Jordan, it is around off and he has rolled his fingers on it. De Kock looks to slam it over the bowler's head but he mistimes it. It balloons high in the air towards mid off. Tom Curran there gobbles it with ease. Third time Jordan removes de Kock in this series. With this wicket, Jordan becomes England's leading wicket-taker in the shortest format of the game, going past Stuart Broad.
Change of pace from Jordan! Length ball outside off, de Kock looks to punch it on the off side but misses.
Short and wide outside off, Bavuma reaches out and cuts it to deep point for one.
Short and down the leg side. De Kock goes for the pull but does so really hard. Jordan offers no pace. De Kock mistimes it down to fine leg for one.
First bowling change of the evening.  Chris Jordan is introduced into the attack.
Takes a single and keeps the strike for the next over. Good bumper from Archer. It is around off and middle, de Kock hops and tucks it on the leg side for one. Another good over for the Proteas.

SIX! BOOM! De Kock winning the battle! What a shot! A length ball on the pads, de Kock flicks it powerfully over deep square leg for the maximum. Morgan made some field changes and got his fine leg finer but de Kock won't care.

FOUR! That is some shot from the South African skipper. Archer bowls a length ball outside off, de Kock moves inside the crease and pulls it over short fine leg for a boundary. He loves that area and has punished Archer there a number of times. Wants to dominate him again.
Length ball around off, blocked.
Shortish and just outside off, Bavuma pushes it to the left of the point fielder for one.
Length ball around off, pushed towards the cover fielder for nothing.
1 run, the batsman goes back in his crease and flick it away through square leg, for a single.
On the pads,de Kock flicks it to the on side for a run.
Tucks this fuller one through mid-wicket and rotates the strike. Sensible from Bavuma.
SIX! Frst biggie of the game and it is a smoking hit. A half-tracker from Sam on middle and off. Bavuma says thank you very much and smokes his pull over square leg for half-a-dozen.
FOUR! Smashed! Short ball n off and middle. Bavuma is quick to get on his back foot and smashes his pull through mid-wicket for a boundary.

Risky single! Shortish and down the leg side, de Kock looks to pull but mistimes it towards short fine leg. They go for the run as Archer from short fine leg has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Single to end! A top over from Archer. Just the 2 run. Good length and around off, de Kock taps it on the off side and keeps the strike for the next over.
Quick single! Length ball around off, Bavuma pushes it towards mid on gently and calls for a single. De Kock responds and they get it easily.
One more dot! This one is full and outside off, Bavuma drives it well but straight to mid off.
Good stop! Short ball outside off, Bavuma punches it hard but finds the cover fielder.
That is a lovely delivery! Just outside off and on a good length, Bavuma looks to drive but misses.
Back of a length ball outside off to begin, it is pushed towards point for nothing.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Jofra Archer. Two slips in place for the strike bowler.
Single to end! A cautious start from South Africa. Decent start from Curran too. A full ball outside off, it is pushed towards the backward point region for a run.
Shortish and just outside off, poked towards point.
Shortish on the pads, Temba looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pad.
Sam goes full and around middle, de Kock pushes it towards mid on and gets to the other end. Three singles to begin.
Bavuma opens his account on the first ball as well. A shortish ball around off, Bavuma pushes it to the right of the point fielder for a single.
De Kock and South Africa are underway! A length ball on the pads, de Kock flicks it through square leg for one.

Right! Done and dusted with the Anthems. The England players take their positions on the field. Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma are the Protea openers. Sam Curran with the ball first up for England. A slip in place. De Kock to face the first ball. Here we go...
We are not too far away from the action! But before that, it is time for the National Anthems! First England and then South Africa.

Jofra Archer is caught for a quick chat! Starts by saying that they have played well in the last couple of games, in spite of not getting the conditions that they expected. Archer says that the wicket has been slower than what they expected. Tells that the pitch for the 2nd game was slightly quicker but here it was slower in the first game. Hopes it offers some pace this time around. Adds that they have not lost enough wickets for him to bat.
England (Unchanged Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (WK), Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Ben Stokes, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Curran, Tom Curran, Jofra Archer, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK/C), Temba Bavuma, Faf du Plessis, Rassie van der Dussen, Pite van Biljon (IN FOR HEINRICH KLAASEN), Reeza Hendricks, George Linde, Lutho Sipamla (IN FOR KAGISO RABADA), Lungi Ngidi, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan, starts by saying that after looking at the wicket, they gave a thought of bringing Ali in the team but since the XI has done well in the last two games, they stick with the same for this game too. Adds that they wanted to play their strongest XI in this series.

South Africa skipper, Quinton de Kock, tells that the decision to bat first is because it is a used wicket and it will get slower as the game goes on. Tells that Rabada has got a niggle while Klaasen has fallen sick. Adds that he is disappointed with the result from the last two games but feels that they did play good cricket. Wants to keep their heads high and win the last game.
TOSS - Time for the flip of the coin! Up it and goes and it lands in South Africa's favor! They will BAT first.

Hello and welcome to the third and final T20I between South Africa and England! It is England who have taken the series already and would be eager to inflict a whitewash! The hosts, on the other hand, would be hoping to turn things around and have a win under their belt before the teams meet for the ODI leg. Let's see how things pan out. Stay with us for the toss and team updates!
